description.value: Free BC Hydro recreation area at a scenic mountain reservoir in the Cascades east of Chilliwack; access is via a forest service road so expect gravel, but the lake setting is a worthwhile payoff on a clear day.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website fetch returned only BC Hydro's generic navigation boilerplate — the actual Jones Lake recreation page content did not render, so all amenity details are sourced from OSM tags only. OSM tags are detailed and internally consistent (operator=BC Hydro, fee=no, tents=yes, toilets=yes, drinking=no, shower=no, reservation=no, washing_machine=no), which aligns with BC Hydro's known practice of operating free, basic recreation areas near its reservoirs. No phone or address is available in OSM.
concerns: Website fetch returned only BC Hydro's generic site navigation; the specific Jones Lake recreation page content did not render, so no amenity details could be confirmed from the website.
No potable water on site (drinking=no) — cyclists should plan to carry or treat water.
No address or phone number available in OSM.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: A legitimate, free BC Hydro-operated campsite near Chilliwack with toilets and picnic tables, no reservation required — a useful no-cost overnight option for touring cyclists on a budget, despite minimal facilities.
enrichment_extras.notes: Site has no potable water; cyclists should arrive self-sufficient for water. The campsite is free with no reservation required per OSM tags.
